title: XGBoost v0.1 Repository Milestone
summary: The official XGBoost repository preserves a v0.1 tag whose referenced commit is dated March 2014. The current official repository identifies XGBoost as originating from a research project at the University of Washington.
significance: A primary-source, month-precision repository milestone for early XGBoost that can be recorded without turning a lightweight Git tag or its commit timestamp into an unsupported exact public-release, invention, or development-start date.

verification.note: The official dmlc/xgboost repository exposes refs/tags/v0.1 pointing to commit 2aa1031d24586a5ad798637fec380ecc01a9b013; GitHub's commit object dates that commit to 2014-03-26T23:47:01Z. The current official repository states that XGBoost originates from a research project at the University of Washington. This candidate records only a March 2014 v0.1 repository milestone. It does not assert that the commit timestamp is an exact public-release date, or infer an invention/system-birth date, development-start date, development geography beyond the repository's explicit institutional-origin statement, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or unsupported relationship edge.

candidateMeta.admissionReason: The official repository preserves a v0.1 tag pointing to a commit dated March 2014, supporting a month-precision repository milestone while not proving an exact public-release date.
candidateMeta.nextStep: Review for chronology-safe canonical admission as a repository milestone. Separately research claim-specific primary evidence for XGBoost's initial public release and earlier development chronology before adding any release, origin, geography, ancestry, influence, causal, or relationship claims.
